Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met a U.S. commander seeking more military support but faces a 'strategic shock' after apparent U.S. rebuffs, amid stalled U.S.-Iran diplomacy, Trump floating US retention of seized Iranian oil akin to Venezuela, and a widening Mideast conflict.
